name: Knight · Moon Knight
description: A slim night-sky paladin in deep violet and moon-silver plate: a sleek domed helm with a silver crescent-moon crest (a star twinkling in its mouth) and a narrow glowing silver-blue visor, a midnight-blue surcoat with a glowing crescent sigil, a long star-scattered cloak with a violet lining, a small crescent buckler on the sword forearm and a slim curved moon-steel sabre with a pale glow. He walks with the sabre in guard and the cloak trailing; his cut draws the sabre back over the shoulder, brings it over the top in a moonlight crescent, lunges through it with sparkles flying and recovers to guard.
